'''Spiritual guardians''' are [[Slayer]] monsters within [[Daemonheim]]. They require a Slayer level of 63 to kill. They can be encountered on Furnished, Abandoned, Occult, and Warped floors, but encounters are uncommon. They are the only monster that can drop the [[protector's ward]] and [[guardian's ward]] shields. As with all slayer monsters within Daemonheim, an encounter is more likely if the party size and floor size is bigger. Contrary to popular belief, they are '''not''' affected by the [[shadow silk hood]].

==Trivia==
*They appear to be spiritual versions of [[forgotten warrior]]s, which makes them similar to [[Spiritual warrior]]s outside of [[Daemonheim]].
* When killed, they make a high-pitched "ping" sound.
